scheduleSummary: BJJ (17/wk): No-Gi Mon-Thu 12pm & 7pm, Sat 12pm; Gi Tue/Thu 8pm, Fri 7pm, Sat 1pm; girls-only No-Gi Tue/Thu 6pm; Competition No-Gi Sun 9:30am (invite). Also Muay Thai, boxing, kickboxing, wrestling, judo, MMA (Mon-Thu 8pm) and 36 fitness classes/week (yoga, Pilates, Xtreme Cycling, Zumba, kettlebell, cross training).
notes: Stretch venue (1.56 km from Kipling), included for BJJ. Its other classes (yoga, spin etc.) are out of the 1.2 km non-BJJ radius. Site: "Nothing needs booking... if it is on the grid, turn up." 33,000 sq ft facility with on-site parking. Membership prices are not published, and no shower statement was found on the site.
